section.contact.title: Contact Diagnostics
section.contact.desc: Directly place probes in plasma to measure core parameters.
section.contact.langmuir.title: XHINS-LP Langmuir Probe Products
section.contact.langmuir.desc: Automated I–V scans for core parameters; supports single/double/triple/emissive probes.
section.contact.langmuir.param3: Plasma potential (V_p), floating potential (V_f), electron energy distribution function (EEDF)
section.contact.faraday.title: XHINS-FP Faraday Probe Products
section.contact.faraday.desc: Measure current density and total current; evaluate plume uniformity and divergence.
section.contact.exb.title: XHINS-EBP E×B Probe (Wien Filter) / Velocity Selector
section.contact.exb.desc: Select ions by charge-to-mass ratio and velocity to identify plume species and ion energy distribution (IEDF).
section.contact.rpa.title: Retarding Potential Analyzer (RPA / RFEA)
section.contact.rpa.desc: Measure ion energy distribution and ion flux; evaluate plasma processing.
section.contact.rpa.param3: Surface treatment and plume uniformity assessment
section.combo.title: Probe Bundles
section.combo.plan1.label: Bundle A
section.combo.plan1.title: Plasma Plume Analysis Kit
section.combo.plan1.p1: Core value: accurately assess thruster health and plume characteristics—an entry kit for performance testing and optimization.
section.combo.plan1.p2: Typical use: ground-vacuum performance tests and plume characterization of ion thrusters or Hall thrusters.
section.combo.plan1.p3: Includes: one Faraday probe set + one RPA set.
section.combo.plan1.p4: Pain point solved: Faraday alone gives current; RPA alone gives energy. Together they deliver a full plume profile—“how strong and how well-directed.”
section.combo.plan1.item1: Ion current density spatial distribution (Faraday): plume angular profile, thrust vector direction, beam focusing.
section.combo.plan1.item2: Ion energy per charge distribution (RPA): effective acceleration voltage, energy utilization, low-energy tail detection.
section.combo.plan2.label: Bundle B
section.combo.plan2.title: Comprehensive Plasma Diagnostics Platform
section.combo.plan2.p1: Core value: deep insight into plasma generation, acceleration, and interactions—ideal for mechanism studies and advanced performance analysis.
section.combo.plan2.p2: Typical use: novel EP R&D, spacecraft–plume interaction, contamination assessment.
section.combo.plan2.p3: Includes: Langmuir probe + Faraday probe + RPA.
section.combo.plan2.p4: Pain point solved: adds Langmuir to diagnose background plasma and potential distribution, covering charging/erosion risks beyond plume strength and energy.
section.combo.plan2.item2: Background electron temperature and density (Langmuir): neutrality level, surface potential prediction.
section.combo.plan2.item3: Plasma potential spatial distribution (Langmuir): electric field profile, ion acceleration, electron transport.
section.combo.plan3.label: Bundle C
section.combo.plan3.title: Particle Energy Analysis Kit
section.combo.plan3.p1: Core value: focuses on energy dimension for detailed diagnostics of energetic electrons and ions.
section.combo.plan3.p2: Typical use: Hall thruster non-ideal effects, high-energy particle studies, cases needing precise energy distribution functions.
section.combo.plan3.p4: Pain point solved: RPA targets ion spectra; EB (electron energy analyzer) yields electron energy distribution to reveal transport and loss mechanisms.
section.combo.plan3.item2: Electron energy distribution function (EB): refined electron temperature and high-energy tail identification.
section.optical.title: Optical Diagnostics
section.optical.desc: Remote measurements via spontaneous emission and light–matter interaction with high selectivity and spatiotemporal resolution.
section.optical.oes.title: Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES)
section.optical.oes.desc: Identify species, measure densities, estimate excitation/electron temperature.
section.optical.lif.title: Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF)
section.optical.lif.desc: Tunable laser excitation for selective detection of density and velocity.
section.optical.thomson.title: Thomson Scattering
section.optical.thomson.desc: Measure elastic scattering spectra of electrons to obtain temperature and density.
section.optical.las.title: Laser Absorption Spectroscopy (LAS)
section.optical.las.desc: Narrow-linewidth laser scans absorption lines for real-time absolute density of specific species.
section.optical.las.param3: Temperature or pressure from absorption line inversion
section.ion.title: Plasma Sources
section.ion.desc: Stable, controllable ion beam assemblies for labs, EP ground systems, and etch/material lines; includes beam conditioning, grid optics, and neutralizer options.
section.ion.kaufman.title: XHINS-KF Kaufman Ion Source Systems
section.ion.kaufman.desc: Ionization chamber with porous anode, neutralizer included; wide energy tuning for ground EP systems and beam research.
section.ion.kaufman.param2: Beam current density: up to mA/cm²
section.ion.hall.title: XHINS-HS Hall Ion Source Systems
section.ion.hall.desc: E×B drift discharge, compact form; supports EP lifetime tests and lab prototypes.
section.ion.cathode.title: XHINS-CA Cathodic Arc Plasma Source Systems
section.ion.cathode.desc: Evaporates and ionizes cathode material to deliver high-current metal ion beams for materials and surface engineering.
section.ion.rfis.title: XHINS-RF RF/ICP Plasma Source Systems
section.ion.rfis.desc: RF-coupled, electrode-free, clean low-damage source for etch/clean lines and research.
section.thrust.title: Micro Thrust Stands
section.thrust.desc: Deliverable thrust stands for low-thrust thrusters and plasma sources, including platform, calibration tools, and test software for vacuum and long-duration runs.
section.thrust.torsion.title: XHINS-TTS Torsional Thrust Stand
section.thrust.torsion.desc: High-sensitivity torsion structure for steady and slowly varying thrust.
section.thrust.em.title: XHINS-ETS Electromagnetic Thrust Stand
section.thrust.em.desc: Electromagnetic/electrostatic balance with closed-loop control and rapid calibration; covers mN-class long-duration thrust.
section.thrust.calibration.title: Calibration, Damping, Compensation, Feedback & Sensing Modules
section.thrust.calibration.desc: DAQ, processing software, and uncertainty tools for thrust stand delivery.
